question: How many students have received financial aid from the Union Ministry of Science and Technology in 2022 under the Inspire scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**53,021**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

 
 
• The **INSPIRE (Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research) scheme** is a flagship program of the **Union Ministry of Science and Technology** aimed at attracting talent to the field of science and research. 
 
• In the year **2022**, a total of **53,021 students** were provided with financial aid under the INSPIRE scheme. 
 
• The scheme is designed to identify and support **scientifically inclined students** from an early age, fostering a strong base for innovation and research in India. 
 
• This initiative provides financial support for various components such as **scholarships, internships, and fellowships** to students pursuing education and research in science.
